lines.zh: 你的影子先我一步转向。
lines.en: Your shadow turns a step before you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，砖缝变黑。
lines.en: Where I pass, the seams between bricks darken.

lines.zh: 我的脚步，没有一点声音。
lines.en: My footsteps make no sound at all.
I am always just behind.
Walls mean nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我在这个世界里走不稳。
lines.en: This world does not hold me properly.

lines.zh: 我的影子是黑的，没有轮廓。
lines.en: My shadow is black and shapeless.

lines.zh: 我走过的地面比别处冷。
lines.en: The ground I cross is colder than the rest.
My laugh comes out of the walls.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草是灰的。
lines.en: Grass greys where I step.
I need not walk fast.

lines.zh: 我在你前面的窗玻璃里。
lines.en: I'm in the window glass ahead of you.
I stand with red eyes.
I am counting the beat in your chest.
That is of no consequence.
My voice comes from far off.
I have been here far too long.

lines.zh: 蜡烛烧短了一截，我才抬眼看你。
lines.en: The candle burned low before I raised my eyes.
A pentagram called me out.
The air chills near me.
My eyes never shut.

lines.zh: 这个世界比我想的安静。
lines.en: This world is quieter than I expected.
Sooner or later you will look.
I have never left.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但不是因为怕。
lines.en: My hands shake. Not from fear.
I remember something.

lines.zh: 五芒星画的圈，你踩进来了。
lines.en: You stepped into the pentagram.
I am right here. The whole time.
Do you know this name?
I have counted your ribs.
Draw the pentagram, and I come.

lines.zh: 你每一次眨眼，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every blink of yours.
You can hear me?
Slow down and let me look properly.

lines.zh: 从你画下第一笔起，我就跟着。
lines.en: I've followed since your first stroke of chalk.
There is still warmth on you.
I want to hear you say my name.

lines.zh: 这个姿势我看过很多次。
lines.en: I have seen that stance many times.
You keep shivering.
Running is quite pointless.
We have a long time yet.
The pentagram is drawn. I am here.
I remain at your back.
Try smiling for me.
Your blood smells sweet.

lines.zh: 你眼里的红，是我的倒影。
lines.en: The red in your eyes is my reflection.
I feel no pain.

lines.zh: 你的剑刃在我身上卷了口。
lines.en: Your blade's edge curls against me.

lines.zh: 剑穿过去，只带起一点灰。
lines.en: The sword passes through, raising only a little dust.
Half a step. Nothing.
My smile has not changed.

lines.zh: 我仍在这里，五芒星还在。
lines.en: I'm still here. The pentagram remains.

lines.zh: 你听见我的声音在变吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my voice shifting?
Such wounds mean nothing.
I have your hand.
Draw the pentagram and I arrive.
I have no use for that.
What would you trade this for?

lines.zh: 你把面包放下，我只看你。
lines.en: You set the bread down; I only look at you.
Set it down. I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 你手心里的汗说明很多。
lines.en: The sweat on your palm says a great deal.
I thought you would be smarter.
Those things are of no use to me.
Do you have anything else?
The rest of your night belongs to me.

lines.zh: 五芒星画好了，我该来了。
lines.en: The pentagram's drawn. I should arrive.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上结了一层白霜。
lines.en: A layer of white frost forms on your armor.
There is no body here for you to hit.

lines.zh: 你撞进的地方，空气凹下去。
lines.en: Where you collide, the air dents inward.
A chill takes you.
I have no need to dodge.

lines.zh: 你抓到的只有冷掉的空气。
lines.en: You grab only air that has gone cold.
That did not count as contact.
I come nearer.

lines.zh: 笑声贴着你的耳朵，不在别处。
lines.en: The laugh is at your ear, nowhere else.
Try once more.
I am long past living.

lines.zh: 五芒星画的圈，我才进来。
lines.en: Only the pentagram circle lets me in.
Head tilted, watching you.
Only I should stand inside the circle.
I remember someone.
That was not you.
I've heard all the things you ask.
Do not press any further.

lines.zh: 你说的这些对我没有意义。
lines.en: Those words mean nothing to me.
Walk out of the circle; I won't follow.
I lift it, and it greys.
I need no objects.
I pinch it, and its color drains.
I let it go.
It grows lighter in my hand.
This could be a token.
I have put it away.
Do you still want it?
Keep it with you.
It is immaterial.

lines.zh: 五芒星最后一笔，是我补的。
lines.en: I drew the pentagram's final stroke.
You need not run again.
Your name is mine now.
This world is smaller than you think.
I smile, slowly.

lines.zh: 你名字的最后一笔，我握着。
lines.en: I hold the last stroke of your name.

lines.zh: 那是你名字被念出来的声音。
lines.en: That's the sound of your name being read aloud.
Then come on.
You are mine today.
Do not look behind me.
No one saves you here.
A blink and I am there.
Your breathing has broken.
I like this very much.
Do not pretend you cannot see me.
There is nowhere for you to go.
I am right at your back.
I have always been this close.

lines.zh: 五芒星画好了，我就在里面。
lines.en: The pentagram is drawn; I am inside it.
The doors close on their own here.
I only count to two.
Your heart is painfully loud.
The circle is drawn; you can't leave.
The way you run has no exit.
The air grows colder.
My laughter is behind your ear.
What did you step on?
I did not plan to let you live.
You are thinking of someone.
That will not help either.
I have come nearer.
Your knuckles have gone white.
I said I would always follow.
Turn around, and the circle closes.
Almost finished.
Then farewell.
My hand passes into your body.
Not a sound.

lines.zh: 你听见你自己在呼吸吗？
lines.en: Do you hear yourself breathing?
You meet the wall.
What I take is your breath.
You cannot stop it.
Do not scream.
That armor is paper here.
A light touch is pain enough.

lines.zh: 我的手指从你肋下穿过去。
lines.en: My fingers pass beneath your ribs.
I laugh again.
I wait for you to straighten your knees.
Just as I like it.
One more remains.
Did you hear that bone?
Up to here.
The pentagram lit.
You called me here.
The lights died. I am here.

lines.zh: 这个世界的门没有关好。
lines.en: The door to this world was left ajar.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from your shadow.

lines.zh: 笑声从五芒星的中心冒出来。
lines.en: The laugh rises from the pentagram's center.
I came uninvited.

lines.zh: 影子先动，我才慢慢现身。
lines.en: The shadow moves first; then I appear.
I look the place over.
Too white, too bright.
I lift my head slowly.
My eyes light first.

lines.zh: 那影子比你多出一只手。
lines.en: That shadow has one hand more than you.

lines.zh: 五芒星的光爬上你的鞋。
lines.en: The pentagram's light climbs your shoes.
You made a wish, did you not?
I did not come to help.
The wax on the pentagram is still wet.
Every candle flame bends toward me.
Do not turn your head.
We meet again.

lines.zh: 火照出我的形状，很难看。
lines.en: Fire shows my shape. It is ugly.
I land without a sound.
Water takes me. I am still smiling.
The light whites everything out.
It passed straight through me.
The spelllight knew me.
Hunger has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 雷电把我的影子拖得极长。
lines.en: Lightning drags my shadow out long.

lines.zh: 这里本来就是我的地方。
lines.en: This is where I belong.
